headline: H1FY27 - Volume led growth; Profitability in focus in H2

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Campus Activewear (CAMACT) CMP: ₹ 200 Target ₹ 250 (25%) Target Period: 12 months November 11, 2026 H1FY27 - Volume led growth; Profitability in focus in H2 About the stock : Campus Activewear (Campus) is India’s leading homegrown sports and athleisure footwear brands, catering to the aspirational mass-premium consumer segment.
Q2FY27 performance : Campus’ consolidated revenues grew by 17% YoY to Rs.452cr driven by 10.3% volume growth to 6.3mn pairs while realisation grew by 6.1% YoY to Rs.713/pair.
Gross margins declined by 246bps YoY to 50.9% impacted by higher input costs.

This along with lower interest cost helped reported PAT grow by 22.4% YoY to Rs.24.3cr in Q2FY27 Investment Rationale: Mid - teen revenue growth guidance retained for FY27 : Campus reported 15% YoY growth in revenues to Rs.837.3cr driven by ~11% YoY growth in volumes growth to ~12.1mn pairs and 3.5% YoY growth in realisation to Rs.695/pair in H1FY27.

Rating and Target Price : We recommend Buy with revised price target of Rs .2 50 (valuing at 32x average FY2 8- 29 E EPS of Rs .7.7 ).
ICICI Direct assigns ratings to its stocks according to their notional target price vs. current market price and then categorizes them as Buy, Hold, Reduce and Sell.
watch: Further, premiumisation and adjacent categories scale up will also be key driver of revenues.
Also, Women’s and kids’ footwear are emerging as key growth drivers, registering 27% and 34% YoY growth, respectively, in H1FY27.
